title: RMOS-PROFILING-CONVERGE-001: gate production profiling G-code through canonical feasibility
intent: Converge the live Profiling manufacturing capability from RUNTIME_REACHABLE + LIVE_UNGOVERNED_OUTPUT (frozen by PR #328) to RUNTIME_REACHABLE + GOVERNED. Production POST /api/cam/profiling/gcode already bound JSON bodies after PR #324; this increment does not repair binding. It places the existing compute_profile_feasibility evaluator and SafetyPolicy structurally before ProfileToolpath.generate(), persists the actual authority decision via validate_and_persist, and fails closed on RED/UNKNOWN/ERROR. No new profiling physics, no second evaluator, no GREEN fallback, no client change, no other capability.
behavior_change: INTENTIONAL AND SIGNIFICANT - safety posture change on one capability. Valid profiling requests still return 200 G-code (GREEN or permitted YELLOW). Block-worthy requests that previously could emit now return 409 SAFETY_BLOCKED with no G-code body and no output artifact hash. Evaluator exceptions and missing engines fail closed. Empty-body 422 from #324 is unchanged. Preview /preview is unchanged.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) profile_router.py production /gcode: ProfileRequest maps to the ProfileConfig the generator actually runs; feasibility inputs come from that config; _authorize_profiling calls compute_feasibility_internal + SafetyPolicy and raises 409 before ProfileToolpath is constructed; allowed runs persist via validate_and_persist with the authority risk and feasibility hash. Preview is untouched. (2) rmos_feasibility_router.py: resolve_mode recognizes profiling:/profile:; compute_profiling_feasibility dispatches to the existing compute_profile_feasibility (not a second evaluator) and maps low/medium/high/blocked onto GREEN/YELLOW/RED so SafetyPolicy can consume it; missing keys UNKNOWN, exceptions ERROR; engine table registers profiling. (3) tests: PROF-001–024 in test_profiling_authority_convergence.py; MAR-012/017 and TC-07/TC-23 updated for the named profiling engine; binding mini-app uses ephemeral RMOS dirs. (4) Registry + Stage-2 overlay: Profiling only, LIVE_UNGOVERNED_OUTPUT → GOVERNED, ungated_output_exposure NO, NAMED evaluator, AUTHORITY_BEFORE_GENERATION. (5) Audit §7 appends the after-state without erasing the frozen before-state. (6) GA-TRIAL-0003 recorded. (7) rmos_ci.yml collects the new witness file without an if-[ -f ] skip.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Not a decorator/binding repair (that was #324) and not a census (#328). The reachable sibling /gcode path had no RMOS authority boundary; this is the first capability-level convergence increment the frozen map made possible. The existing evaluator is reused; finishing defaults are passed only because ProfileToolpath.generate() actually uses them. No GREEN fallback, no new physics, no other capability.
